title: HB 2038 (2023-2024 biennium (2023 Regular Session)): Requiring postsecondary educational institutions to indicate when a student's identification issued by such institution cannot be used for voting purposes. (printed long title: AN ACT concerning elections; relating to voter identification; requiring postsecondary educational institutions to indicate when a student's identification issued by such institution cannot be used for voting purposes; amending K.S.A. 25-1122d and K.S.A. 2022 Supp. 25-2908 and repealing the existing sections.)
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) K.S.A. 2022 Supp. 25-2908(b) as printed in Sec. 3 (reprinted existing law; rendered page 3 shows no marking)
(quote) (b) A person desiring to vote shall provide to the election board: (1) The voter's name; (2) if required, the voter's address; (3) the voter's signature on the registration or poll book; and (4) a valid form of identification listed in subsection (h).
(section) K.S.A. 2022 Supp. 25-2908(h)(1) as printed in Sec. 3 (reprinted existing law; one small wording change at (G), "of education" struck and "educational" added)
(quote) (G) a student identification card issued by an accredited postsecondary educational institution of education in the state of Kansas;
(b_no_id_remedy)
(section) K.S.A. 2022 Supp. 25-2908(d) as printed in Sec. 3 (reprinted existing law)
(quote) (d) If a voter is unable or refuses to provide current and valid identification, the voter may vote a provisional ballot pursuant to K.S.A. 25-409, and amendments thereto.
(c_mail_ballot_id)
(section) K.S.A. 25-1122d(a) as printed in Sec. 2 (affirmation form for a mailed advance ballot application; reprinted existing law apart from a wording change to the student ID line, rendered page 2)
(quote) I understand that a current and valid Kansas driver's license number or Kansas nondriver's identification card number must be provided in order to receive a ballot. If I do not have a current and valid Kansas driver's license number or Kansas nondriver's identification card number, I must provide one of the following forms of identification with this application in order to receive a ballot:
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) New Section 1(a) (new text)
(quote) (a) Any accredited postsecondary educational institution in this state that issues a student identification card to a student and knows such student is not a citizen of the United States or is otherwise not a legally qualified voter shall include the following statement on the front of such student's identification card: "Cannot be used for voting purposes."
(other) Sec. 4-5: repealer and effective date on publication in the statute book.
